newsitem.title: FRANCE: France taps out last Morse message.
newsitem.headline: France taps out last Morse message.

text.p: France's coastguard was due to tap out its final message in Morse code on Friday, dropping the 157-year-old radio-transmitted sounds for modern satellite and radiotelephone transmissions.

"Calling all. This is our last cry before our eternal silence," was the message due to go out at midnight (2300 GMT) from Le Conquet outpost on the western tip of Brittany to anyone still listening, operators said.
The United States, Belgium and Germany have already dropped the outdated technique whose SOS call has saved countless lives at sea.
Morse will effectively be outdated in 1999 when the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System which sends out distress signals at the touch of a button becomes compulsory.
